  cache._viewVer = undefined;
  cache._projVer = undefined;
  cache._vpVer = undefined;

  void getCameraPosition(camera);
  void getViewMatrix(camera);
}

  const cache = camera as unknown as CameraCacheVersions;
  cache._viewVer = undefined;
  cache._vpVer = undefined;

  void getCameraPosition(camera);
  void getViewMatrix(camera);
}
